page: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server featuring eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with a total of 320 GB of VRAM. The host system is powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor running at 2.2 GHz, providing 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 680.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.08 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile. Single-core CPU performance is weak, as evidenced by bottom-25% results in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities are strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core and uncached memory read/write operations. The server excels in GPU-accelerated tasks, achieving top-tier performance in large language model inference prompt processing across 135M, 7B, and 70B models, as well as top-tier text generation for 7B and 70B models. Ray tracing benchmarks also rank in the top 25%.

Given the high density of specialized hardware, this server represents a significant resource commitment. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on massive parallel processing and GPU-bound workloads rather than general-purpose compute. It is designed for workloads such as large language model inference, deep learning training, ray tracing, and high-throughput multi-threaded applications. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring local NVMe storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for parallel computing and machine learning workloads. It features eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with 320 GB of total VRAM, paired with an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor providing 96 dedicated vCPUs and 680.0 GB of system memory. While single-core CPU benchmarks show weak performance, the server demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and top-tier performance in large language model inference prompt processing and text generation. It lacks local storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This server is structured for GPU-intensive applications, including deep learning, ray tracing, and high-throughput multi-threaded processing, where the high density of accelerators justifies the hardware class investment.
